stemMd: Why was a different storage location useful?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It guaranteed that files would never become corrupt.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It proved the original cupboard was already flooded.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It reduced exposure of all copies to the same local disaster.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It reduced the number of copies to one.

explanationMd: Separating locations can prevent one cupboard-level fire or flood from affecting every copy. This addresses shared physical risk. It does not by itself prove file integrity or remove the need to test restoration.

distractorRationale.a: Geographic separation does not eliminate every type of failure.
distractorRationale.d: The passage treats recovery testing as another requirement.
distractorRationale.b: The hazard was a possibility, not a reported event.
